blocks.x: Contracts that pass independent audits at zero highs: formal-verified cores with invariant coverage measured, fuzzing that runs around the clock, upgrade discipline that removes ambush risk — and a spec written before the first line of Solidity.
The specification is the contract; the code is just its executable form

Smart contracts are business law in executable form — and like law, the writing matters more than the cleverness. The practice is boring on purpose: minimal contract surfaces, formal verification of the core, independent audits with zero high-severity findings, and upgrade mechanisms (proxies, governance) that are themselves audited.

The lifecycle is the discipline: spec first, audit before deploy, staged rollout with monitoring, and an incident path rehearsed like any production system — because a contract bug is a business-logic bug with finality.
Below: the failure modes that put vulnerabilities on mainnet, the reference architecture of the verification pipeline, and the console that tracks audit readiness.
Four failure modes that put vulnerabilities on mainnet
Each of these has shipped eight-figure incidents — the countermeasures front-load specification, verification and upgrade discipline so the bugs never deploy.

widgets.title: The assurance pipeline — click stages for the gate

stages.name: Spec
stages.detail: State invariants and trust model written before code; every invariant is an executable property the fuzzer will attack for the rest of the project.

stages.name: Build
stages.detail: Implementation against spec with the fuzz harness in CI — violations block merges, and every fix strengthens a property rather than patching a symptom.

stages.name: Review
stages.detail: Internal review runs adversarial passes (economic exploits, griefing, oracle windows) with findings filed against invariants — the list auditors later see is short by design.

stages.name: Audit
stages.detail: External audit with the spec attached; findings triaged with the same invariant discipline, and the audit report becomes part of the deploy evidence.

stages.name: Deploy
stages.detail: Deployment via key ceremony with timelock and pause authority defined; post-deploy monitoring watches invariant proxies on mainnet state.

widgets.note: The pipeline's point: auditors confirm, they do not discover — the classes they find were excluded by construction.
